reviews.text: My skin has never been this moisturized! I pair this with the Dokdo moisturizer as well, and my skin is super glowy and hydrated after. I find this helpful because some prescriptions that I use dry out my skin, but my skin hasn’t been dry after using this!
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚從來都冇咁滋潤過！我配合 Dokdo 保濕霜一齊用，用完之後我嘅皮膚超級有光澤、水潤。我覺得好有用，因為我用嘅某啲處方藥會令皮膚乾燥，但係用咗呢款之後，我嘅皮膚就唔會乾。

reviews.text: I really love this hyaluronic acid serum! It feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin soft, smooth, and deeply hydrated. It gives my skin a fresh, plump look without feeling sticky. A great addition to my daily skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款透明質酸精華！質地輕盈，吸收快，令皮膚柔軟、順滑、深層補水。佢令皮膚有種清新、飽滿嘅感覺，又唔會黏膩。係我日常護膚程序嘅好加分項目！

reviews.text: Очень понравилась ампула! Лёгкая, быстро впитывается и отлично увлажняет кожу. После использования лицо становится мягким, свежим и ухоженным. Не липнет, подходит даже для чувствительной кожи. Отличный вариант для ежедневного ухода
reviews.zh: 非常喜歡呢款安瓶！質地輕盈，好快吸收，補濕效果好好。用完之後，面部感覺柔軟、清新、護理得好好。唔黏，即使敏感皮膚都啱用。係日常護理嘅好選擇。

reviews.text: ive been using the toner for years so i wanted to try the serum and its soooo good. when i first put it on my skin was dense but once uou start spreading it its so lightweight and not heavy at all. its soo good and hydrating. i have sensitive skin but its so soothing too
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款化妝水好多年，所以想試吓精華，佢真係好好用。啱啱塗嗰陣質感濃稠，但一開始推開，就好輕盈，一啲都唔重。好好用，又好補濕。我皮膚敏感，但佢都好舒緩。

reviews.text: I use this serum 2X a day (morning and evening), with the other Dokdo products. I have combo skin and am very sensitive, so I was happy that I could use this serum without any skin irritation. I use this product after the Dokdo cleanser (morning routine) or after the Dokdo Toner (evening routine). I only need 3 drops. However, it takes a while for my skin to absorb this, and if I use too much, it makes my skin feel sticky even after several minutes of drying time. Using too much makes my skin look oily, so I had to play around with drop sizes and how many drops I was using to find what worked for me.
reviews.zh: 我每日用兩次呢款精華（早上同晚上），同其他 Dokdo 產品一齊用。我係混合皮膚，而且好敏感，所以好開心可以用呢款精華而冇任何皮膚刺激。我早上會喺 Dokdo 潔面產品之後用（早上護膚程序），晚上就喺 Dokdo 化妝水之後用（晚上護膚程序）。我只需要用 3 滴。不過，佢要一陣時間先被皮膚吸收，如果我用多咗，即使乾咗幾分鐘，都會令皮膚覺得黏。用太多令皮膚睇落油油地，所以我要試吓滴數同用幾多滴，先搵到啱我嘅方法。

reviews.text:
Il est incroyable je ne comprends pas qu'il ne soit pas plus connu! Premier produit coreen que j'ai eu et à lui seul m'à donne une peau tellement plus belle, hydratée et surtout à fait disparaître mes tâches sombres qu'il m'a donne envie de me mettre à la skin care coreenne je le recommande
à 100% ainsi que beaucoup d'autres produits de la marque round lab d'ailleurs qui est excellente
reviews.zh: 佢真係好犀利，我唔明點解佢唔係更出名！我用過嘅第一款韓國產品，單靠佢已經令我皮膚靚咗好多、水潤咗好多，仲完全消除咗我嘅暗斑，令我好想開始用韓國護膚。我 100% 推薦，另外 round lab 品牌嘅好多其他產品都好好，呢個品牌真係好出色。

reviews.text: Il est incroyable je ne comprends pas qu’il ne soit pas plus connu! Premier produit coreen que j’ai eu et à lui seul m’à donne une peau tellement plus belle, hydratée et surtout à fait disparaître mes tâches sombres qu’il m’a donne envie de me mettre à la skin care coreenne 😉 je le recommande à 100% ainsi que beaucoup d’autres produits de la marque round lab d’ailleurs qui est excellente
reviews.zh: 佢真係好犀利，我唔明點解佢唔係更出名！我用過嘅第一款韓國產品，單靠佢已經令我皮膚靚咗好多、水潤咗好多，仲完全消除咗我嘅暗斑，令我好想開始用韓國護膚 😉 我 100% 推薦，另外 round lab 品牌嘅好多其他產品都好好，呢個品牌真係好出色。

reviews.text: I love the Dokdo line so much! I don’t really think this is worth spending your money on since you can just layer the Dokdo toner instead to get the same results but this isn’t a bad product by any means. it’s watery and doesn’t leave your skin sticky (doesn’t have a scent).
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Dokdo 系列！我真係唔覺得呢款值得你花錢，因為你可以直接疊搽 Dokdo 化妝水，效果一樣；不過呢款都唔係壞產品。佢係水狀嘅，用完唔會令皮膚黏（冇味）。
